source_title: Lucid Private Offices Officially Opens in Austin Amid Growing Demand for Private, Flexible Office Space - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
New 22,000-square-foot location in Arboretum/Domain brings premium private offices to one of the nation's growing flex workspace markets
AUSTIN, Texas , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Lucid Private Offices , a national premium coworking company with a focus on private offices, officially opens its first Austin location at Arboretum/Domain in Stonebridge Plaza in North Austin on November 1, 2026.
Austin marks the newest market in Lucid's continued expansion across the Sun Belt, building on an established footprint in Texas, Georgia, Arizona and Tennessee. The opening comes as companies increasingly embrace flexible workplace solutions that provide greater agility and support hybrid teams.
The trend is particularly evident in Austin. The city now has approximately 2 million square feet of coworking space across 108 locations, according to CoworkingCafe and Yardi data , while JLL has identified Austin as a Sun Belt market experiencing accelerated growth in flexible office space.
Additionally, newly released data released this week from the 2025 Central Texas Commuter Survey found that 45% of surveyed residents across the region work from home at least some of the time - reinforcing the demand for professional and flexible workspaces.
Designed to meet the needs of today's businesses and professionals, Lucid Private Offices' new 22,329-square-foot Austin location combines flexible workspace with the privacy, amenities, and elevated design of a premium office environment. Occupying the entire ninth floor of Stonebridge Plaza, a Class A, LEED-certified office complex between the Arboretum and the Domain, the space features 83 private offices, 12 team suites, four conference rooms, and a dedicated Library Focus room, with views of the Texas Hill Country and the Domain.
As Austin's flexible workspace market continues to grow, Lucid Private Offices is introducing a distinctly different approach that prioritizes privacy, productivity, and sophisticated design without sacrificing the flexibility, amenities, and sense of community that professionals value.
Unlike traditional coworking environments centered around shared desks and open communal spaces, Lucid Private Offices offers a more sophisticated alternative that prioritizes private offices and team suites while maintaining the flexibility and sense of community of coworking. With thoughtfully designed interiors, premium finishes, beautifully appointed meeting rooms and hospitality-driven services, Lucid creates an elevated professional environment that inspires productivity, encourages collaboration and reflects the caliber of the businesses that call it home.
The space provides customizable, white-labeled workspaces on flexible terms, along with professional reception services, enterprise-grade Wi-Fi, and 24/7 access to your locked private office with flexible furnishing options and regular networking and community events. Plus, members get access to the building's fitness center and new amenities lounge. The location is also conveniently situated at the intersection of MoPac Expressway (Loop 1) and Highway 183, between the Arboretum and the Domain district and is minutes from more than 200 shops and 50 restaurants. "While there's no shortage of coworking spaces in Austin, we saw an opportunity to bring something fresh to the Austin office market that delivers exactly what local professionals need and want in office space," said Flip Howard, founder and CEO of Lucid Private Offices . "Professionals shouldn't have to choose between the privacy of a traditional office and the flexibility and amenities of coworking. We bring the best of both together in a sophisticated, thoughtfully designed environment that inspires productivity and gives businesses a place they're proud to call their own."
The Arboretum/Domain space is the first phase of Lucid Private Offices launching into the Austin Market â with plans to have three locations across the Austin area by the end of 2027. Its second location in Westlake is scheduled to open in April 2027 and will bring 23,029 square feet to Suite 200 of the Class A Las Cimas III building along the Capital of Texas Highway (Loop 360). Westlake will serve the established firms and Hill Country commuters of Austin's affluent western gateway with roughly 90 private offices, a dozen-plus team suites, and five conference and meeting rooms.

About Lucid Private Offices For 25 years, Lucid Private Offices (Lucid) has been providing premium flexible workspaces to businesses leaders and communities. Today, Lucid has 30 locations across Austin , Dallas , Houston , Phoenix , Atlanta , and Nashville . Designed for today's professionals and businesses, Lucid offers a modern, refined approach to flexible workspaces, combining thoughtfully designed private offices with the convenience and amenities businesses need to work productively from day one.
Each Lucid location offers a sophisticated, unbranded professional environment with customizable, fully furnished private offices and team suites designed to accommodate solo professionals and businesses with teams of up to 50.
